## Public outcome

Describe the bounded user-visible change and why it belongs in the local-first
Community core.

## Contract and non-goals

- Authority or mutation surface changed:
- Explicit non-goals:
- Fail-closed behavior:

## Qualification

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Complete source suite passes with zero skips.
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_public_release.py --repository .` passes.
- [ ] Fixtures and evidence are wholly synthetic and public-safe.
- [ ] Documentation and reason codes match the product behavior.
- [ ] Commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.

Do not include secrets, private source, prompts, raw `.sigma` data, filesystem
paths, hostnames, customer data, or internal approval/evidence material.
